description: Use when the person asks how far a flow/pipeline run is, whether it finished, why it stopped or hangs, or what a step returned. State of a Flow (Pipeline) run started with lab_flow_starten: the run's status (wartet, laeuft, fertig, fehlgeschlagen, abgebrochen) and, per node, its status, attempts, result and error. A node's result is exactly what its tool returned — ids from there go into the next tools. With `angebot_id` instead of `lauf_id` it finds the run started from that offer — `gefunden: false` means no run was created from it, so nothing was charged for it.

angebot_id.description: From lab_flow_angebot — finds the run started from this offer (when lab_flow_starten's answer was lost)

name: lab_flow_status
title: Flow Run Status
